2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the present transfer petition has been filed under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure for transfer in the Court of Principal Family Judge,
Family Court, Hazaribagh of Original Matrimonial Suit No.193 of 2024 pending in the Court of Principal Family Judge, Family Court, Jamshedpur filed by the sole opposite party against the present petitioner (wife) for dissolution of marriage.

sentences.text: 4. It has further been submitted that the petitioner was married with the opposite party/husband in accordance with Hindu rights and customs on 23.04.2019.

Just after 2-3 months of marriage due to additional demand of dowry and consequent torture meted with the petitioner, she was driven out from her matrimonial home and she lodged a criminal case against her husband vide Chauparan P.S. Case No.91 of 2022 registered for the offences under Sections 341, 323, 312, and 498A read with 2025:JHHC:13999 Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The petitioner has also filed Protest-cum-Complaint Case being Complaint Case No.2760 of 2023 against the opposite party/husband.

It is further submitted that in order to avoid the proceedings of the case instituted Dipali Kumari vs Mayank Shekhar on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17142517/
1 by the petitioner, her husband has filed O.M.S. No.193 of 2024 for dissolution of marriage before the Court of Principal Family Judge, Family Court, Jamshedpur.

entities.text: Court of Principal Family Judge, Family Court, Jamshedpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is a helpless lady having no source of income and no support of any kind, is unable to attend the Court at Jamshedpur travelling from Hazaribagh.
The nature of case also not require any special evidence which might have been adduced only in the Court of Jamshedpur.
Therefore, the transfer of the case would not prejudice the opposite party.

Hence, O.M.S. No.193 of 2024 may kindly be transferred from the Court of Principal Family Judge, Family Court, Jamshedpur to the Court of Principal Family Judge,
Family Court, Hazaribagh.

sentences.text: 5. No contest has been made by the opposite party as no one has appeared on behalf of him.

6. Considering the above facts and circumstances as revealed by the learned counsel for the petitioner, it appears expedient in the ends of justice to transfer the O.M.S. No.193 of 2024 from the Court of Principal Family Judge, Family Court, Jamshedpur to the Court of Principal Family Judge,
Family Court, Hazaribagh.
